ShortDescription.Value: Auto-Clean garbage OR use Trash Boss = Self manage trucks + facilities

Publish.LongDescription:
**Magic Garbage + Trash Boss**
✅ OPTION 1, SELF MANAGE - Trash Boss
- 🚚 Keep normal garbage service and trucks driving around, with more control. - Adjust Truck load capacity - useful for bigger cities. - Adjust storage, processing rate, and total trucks per facility. - Applies your settings once, then stays idle - best for performance.
### How game 1.6.2 smart pickups work
- Buildings request a garbage truck after accumulating ~0.4t. - Trucks also collect side jobs above 0.05t while traveling to the actual "assigned" building. - As the truck fills, the game raises that 0.05t minimum and skips more small side jobs. - A side job that still qualifies can use all remaining truck space. - Trucks are *more likely* to reach assigned buildings, but it's not guaranteed (capacity is important).
### NEW MG Target Reserve
- Controls how soon small side jobs start being skipped; truck still does larger side jobs. - MG Target Reserve: 10–25% optional; vanilla is 10%. Recommended 15% if you want a safer margin. - Target Reserve changes the criteria for side job pickup — it does not add the truck capacity needed to keep up. - Truck Load adds real capacity so each truck can collect more before returning. - Adjust total trucks, storage, and processing rate when your city still cannot keep up.
✅ OPTION 2, AUTO CLEAN - Magic - Clears garbage automatically. - Keeps garbage warning icons away. - Garbage service stays active; cleanup is just very fast.
### Support and feedback - Enjoy! The best way to support the mod is to give it a Like. - Feedback links for GitHub and Discord are on the right of this page.
---
### Compatibility - Safe to remove any time. - Does not use Harmony. - Designed to stay lightweight during normal gameplay.
---
### Bonus status report - Check how your garbage service is doing from Options. - Spot buildings at 7t before garbage warning icons appear. - Compare garbage made, processing capacity, requests, trucks, and facilities. - Status runs only while Options is open. - Detailed Status writes extra information to MagicGarbage.log.
**11+ Languages supported** - Hello, Bonjour, Hallo, Hola, Ciao, 안녕하세요, こんにちは, Olá, Cześć, 你好, 你好, Xin chào
